items.title: Orthopedic Traumatology Research Group
items.summary: Orthopedic Traumatology research group at Inselspital conducts clinical studies on knee ligament injuries and complex knee arthroplasty—relevant for ice hockey injury prevention and treatment.
items.evidence: The main focus of the knee research group lies in the establishment of 3-dimensional templating for fracture repair and ligament reconstructions and on-site 3D printing of surgical guides. Further research activities include clinical studies on ligamentous injuries of the knee and complex knee arthroplasty.

items.title: ARTORG Musculoskeletal Biomechanics Group
items.summary: ARTORG Musculoskeletal Biomechanics Group provides expertise in biomechanical modeling of bone and implants, applicable to analyzing impact forces and protective equipment effectiveness in ice hockey.
items.evidence: Motivated by prevention, diagnosis, and treatment of bone diseases, the research of the Musculoskeletal Biomechanics Group focuses on multi-scale structure-function relationships of bone from the extracellular matrix to the organ level.

items.title: ARTORG Tissue under Forces Lab
items.summary: ARTORG Tissue under Forces lab creates organ-on-chip models to simulate tissue responses to mechanical stress—useful for studying ice hockey impact injuries and testing protective gear.
items.evidence: The group develops a novel alveoli-on-chip platform for modeling cyclic stretch in patient-derived alveolar epithelial cells cultured from organoids.

items.title: Center for Artificial Intelligence in Medicine (CAIM)
items.summary: CAIM platform uses AI to analyze complex cardiac data for personalized diagnosis and treatment of injuries, supporting athlete cardiac screening and rehabilitation planning for ice hockey players.
items.evidence: Only AI can evaluate these many variables quickly in their entirety. We want to let the data speak to better understand what exactly happens during myocarditis.

items.title: CAS in Movement and Sports Therapy
items.summary: CAS in Movement and Sports Therapy offers specialized training for designing rehabilitation programs for athletes recovering from chronic injuries, including those common in ice hockey.
items.evidence: Der CAS-Studiengang Bewegungs- und Sporttherapie bei chronischen Erkrankungen ist eine berufsbegleitende, praxisorientierte und theoriegestützte Spezialausbildung.
